hero.heading: Facial & Underarm Waxing
hero.body: Quick, gentle waxing with skin-soothing aftercare. Smooth results that last weeks longer than shaving, in appointments short enough for a lunch break.

image.alt: Relaxing treatment room at Rosemary Esthetics in Idaho Falls

items: Hair length: about 2 weeks of growth (roughly 1/4 inch) gives the best result.
Skip retinol and strong exfoliants near the area for several days before waxing.
We can't wax over active wounds, sunburn, cold sores, or irritated skin. Reach out if you're unsure.
Aftercare: avoid heavy sun, heat, and heavy makeup on the area for 24 hours.
